name: Chest Supported Lateral Raise
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench set to about 30 degrees, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise the dumbbells out to your sides.
Lift until your arms are roughly in line with your torso.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A lateral raise performed chest-down on an incline bench to remove momentum and isolate the side delts.
